reason: I'd probably take the free call and look at the 15 companies, because that costs me nothing. But my buyers know me personally, and I won't let an agency in Sofia send messages with my name on them until I've seen that it works for a manufacturer like us, not just a logistics firm.
objection: A message signed by me that sounds wrong to the buyer damages a relationship that took me years to build. And three hours sounds fine on paper, but my team is always busy and I'm the one who ends up checking every message.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 has companies I didn't already know and would really want, and they let me talk to a manufacturing or export client who got real quote requests through the Relationship mode, I'd start the pilot before our next trade fair.
